# Native route gap capture

The anonymous Apex probes in this directory were captured in a fresh Developer scratch org with a 30-day duration and no features or settings. The org was deleted and its absence verified through the Dev Hub. `org.tsv` transcribes framed assertion messages. Each probe includes Account and a synthetic missing-object control. The SOSL observation covers API 68 only; no other SOSL API version is inferred.
